children: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (TWSE:2330) reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$46.72 billion, up 41.2% year over year, and a 66.4% gross margin. It forecast Q4 revenue of US$52.3–54.3 billion and gross margin of 65%–67%.
: TSMC (2330) reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$46.72 billion, up 41.2% year over year, with a 66.4% gross margin. It forecast Q4 revenue of US$52.3–54.3 billion and gross margin of 65%–67%.
: TSMC is weighing 3D DRAM production at Nvidia’s request, considering new factories or converting an existing site. No production timeline has been reported.
: TSMC (2330) leads AI chip packaging with CoWoS, but capacity limits have pushed designers to seek other suppliers. Its CoPoS pilot line is set up, with production expected in the next few years.
: TSMC (2330) plans to build 13 leading-edge and advanced-packaging fabs in Taiwan over the next several years, keeping its most advanced production expansion at home.
: TSMC and Tesla may reopen talks on Tesla’s proposed Texas Terafab, with TSMC potentially leading construction and operations. Ownership and investment terms remain under discussion.
: - Bernstein maintained its Outperform rating on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Sponsored ADR (2330) and raised its price target to $600 from $554.
: ARK Invest sold about 56,000 Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ADR shares last week for roughly $24.6 million, or $440 each. The stock had gained more than 75% since ARK bought in July 2026.
: Taiwan Semiconductor (2330) raised T$14.8 billion (US$451 million) in unsecured bonds, priced at yields of 2.3% and 2.42%. Proceeds will fund clean-energy buildings and environmental measures.
